name: Chickpea Lettuce Wraps with Tomato, Corn, Feta & Soy-Glazed Pumpkin Seeds (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses 8 medium and 4 mini food storage containers.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper.
Place pumpkin seeds, soy sauce, and maple syrup in a medium bowl, then stir to combine. Transfer seeds to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup pumpkin seeds
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tsp pure maple syrup

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring seeds halfway through, until golden and toasted, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool (the seeds will harden as they cool).
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 head butter (Boston) lettuce
1 lime
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Divide between four of the medium storage containers, cover, and set aside.
Zest and juice lime into the reserved bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and crushed red pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve or quarter grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and rinse chickpeas in a colander. Add to the bowl.

Place corn in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost. Add to the bowl, along with feta, and stir to combine the chickpea salad. Divide between the remaining medium containers.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups frozen corn
1 (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Break apart the cooled pumpkin seeds. Divide between the mini containers, cover, and add to the containers with the chickpea salad.
Refrigerate containers until ready to eat. Fill lettuce cups with chickpea salad, sprinkle with pumpkin seeds, and enjoy!
